entities.summary: Amy Lynn Webb is an American futurist, author and founder and CEO of the Future Today Strategy Group. She is an adjunct assistant professor at New York University's Stern School of Business, a nonresident senior fellow at Atlantic Council, and was a 2014–15 Visiting Nieman Fellow at Harvard University.
